company.title: About Bronze Metal
company.lead: Founded in 1980, Bronze Metal supplies technical bronze and copper alloys to industries at home and abroad, focused on performance, precision, and engineering support.
company.mission: Deliver alloys and technical support that enable critical engineering projects, with certified quality and reliable lead times.
company.vision: To be the Latin American reference for specialty bronze and copper alloys.
company.capabilities: Solid bars, bushings, and cast profiles in specialty alloys. Bushing diameters up to 3,600 mm. Support for SAE, ASTM, AMS, and UNS specifications.

products.indexLead: Eight families cover high-strength, electrical conductivity, and corrosion-resistance applications.
